results.description:
A calorie counter that's actually free. No subscription, no paywall, no
account — just a fast, private calorie tracker that takes seconds to use.

Most calorie tracking apps put barcode scanning, macros, or AI behind a
monthly fee. This one doesn't. Every tracking feature below is free.

AI CALORIE TRACKER
Point your camera at your plate. The AI identifies the foods, estimates
portions, and fills in calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Every result is
clearly labeled an estimate and fully editable before you log it — you stay
in control of the numbers. You get free AI scans every single day.

A FREE CALORIE COUNTER APP THAT LOGS IN SECONDS
• Search 260+ built-in foods with typo-tolerant search
• Scan any barcode — powered by the Open Food Facts database
• Scan a nutrition label with your camera to create a custom food
• Build multi-ingredient meals and save them for one-tap logging
• Copy yesterday, quick-add calories, favorites and recents

TRACK WORKOUTS TOO
Log a run, a walk, or a lifting session in two taps and see the calories you
burned. Not sure what something burned? Describe it in your own words and AI
estimates it for you. Burned calories can add back to your daily budget — or
not, if you'd rather keep a fixed target. Your choice, in Settings.

SEE YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
A clean dashboard shows calories left, protein, carbs, and fat with progress
rings, plus a week strip so you can spot trends instantly.

YOUR GOALS, COMPUTED PROPERLY
Onboarding uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation — the same formula dietitians
use — to set a realistic daily calorie and macro plan. You choose the pace,
from gradual to aggressive, and see the date each one actually lands on.
Sensible limits are built in: the app won't push you past a safe rate of loss
or below a safe minimum of calories, no matter what you pick.

APPLE HEALTH, DONE RIGHT
Optionally connect Apple Health to see your steps, workouts, active calories,
and distance next to your nutrition — and sync your weight. Read-only, never
uploaded anywhere, and the app works fully without it.

TRACK MORE THAN FOOD
• Water tracker with a daily goal
• Weight log with trend chart and goal line
• Progress charts: calories, activity, streaks
• Streak protection — one gentle nudge before a streak breaks
• Daily notes, calendar history, CSV export
• Home Screen widgets

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything you log stays on your device. No account. If you use AI Photo Scan,
the photo is analyzed and discarded — never stored, never used to train
anything, never linked to you. A few small banner ads keep the app free;
they are never targeted using your data, and nothing about your food, weight,
or Apple Health data is ever sent to an advertiser.

WHY IT'S FREE
Free calorie counter apps usually aren't — they're trials. This one is
supported by a few small banner ads and nothing else. No subscription prompt,
no locked features, no "upgrade to see your macros."

Download the calorie tracker free, keep your data on your device, and cancel
nothing — because there's nothing to cancel.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Calorie Tracker + Counter is not a medical device and does not provide medical
advice, diagnosis or treatment. Calorie and macro targets are general
estimates. Always consult your doctor or a registered dietitian in addition to
using this app, and before making any medical decisions or significant changes
to your diet or exercise — especially if you are pregnant, have a medical
condition, or have a history of disordered eating. Nutrition values and AI
estimates are approximate — always verify against packaging when accuracy
matters.

The New York Times called it simpler, quicker, and better-looking than the competition. Featured in Today's Dietitian.

WHY PEOPLE SWITCH

Accuracy: MyNetDiary runs on a staff-verified food database of over 2 million foods with up to 108 nutrients per entry, built on USDA and NCC research-grade sources, the same databases used in clinical research. An independent 2026 study in Nutrition and Health found MyNetDiary's calorie totals within 5 calories of the reference records and rated it highest of 17 apps for overall quality.

Speed: In our January 2026 test, we logged the same 127 foods in every major app over a week. MyNetDiary took 31% fewer taps than the most popular calorie tracker.

Results: In a peer-reviewed JMIR study of 5,132 MyNetDiary users (2026), those who tracked food 6-7 days a week lost 11.33% of body weight on average over 6 months.

Value: The free version is generous, with barcode scanning, full macro tracking, 108 nutrients, and water tracking. No ads, no account required, no paywall tricks.
